Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool Faces Issues; Trump Blames Vandalism

The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool is experiencing problems with algae-green water and peeling blue paint, leading to its scheduled draining. This comes after a recent renovation, costing over $14 million, was completed. Former President Donald Trump has attributed these issues to "vandalism," specifically claiming a 350-foot gash was deliberately cut into the pool and stating that six individuals were arrested for damaging it. However, these claims of vandalism have been made without presented evidence.
